notes.title: All New Space Ace Released!
notes.content:
We're happy to report that we've finally overhauled the entire game. I know we're a little late from when we said we would have things updated, so thanks for holding out hope.

This version has fresh videos, menus and now works on Windows 10 and Linux!
We've also added controller support, and a fresh Watch Game feature.

For fans of the series -- Dragon's Lair and Dragon's Lair 2: Time Warp have both been updated this month as well.

Thanks again for keeping classic games alive.

notes.title: Now Available - Space Ace
notes.content:
Space Ace is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

In Space Ace you play the heroic Ace who must stop the evil Commander Borf from taking over the Earth! Borf plans to reduce all of humankind to infants and take over the planet. Only two people have the courage and strength to stop Borf and save Earth: the beautiful Kimberly and the heroic Ace. But as they approach Borf's stronghold, Ace is hit by the Infanto Ray, changing him into a child, and Kimberly is kidnapped by the evil madman!

The Fate Of Earth Is In Your hands!

*Offer ends September 3rd at 10AM Pacific Time
